excerpt: ggml-openvino: CI op-test fixes and NPU improvements (#33088) ggml-openvino: KV-only prefill on the static path, with one decode step for the outputs On the static path (NPU, or any device with GGML_OPENVINO_FORCE_STATIC=1) the prefill model of a graph with KV-shared attention layers is compiled with only the cache writes as outputs. The new conversion pass KeepCacheResults (openvino/pass/keep_cache_results.cpp, registered in pass_registry/common.cpp from GraphTraits::kv_only_outputs) removes the other Results and the Parameters nothing reads any more, so OpenVINO drops everything that only feeds the logits: for models whose tail layers read an earlier layer's KV (Gemma 3n/4 E-series) every KV-shared layer and the LM head. When the batch needs logits, the decode model is run once on the output token: it rewrites that token's KV rows with the same values and runs the dropped layers against the complete cache. The decoder keeps its full output list and only reports which outputs are caches; an imported cached model takes the cache outputs as its output names. It is on by default and applies only where it pays off and is valid: graphs with KV-shared attention, at most one output token per batch, and no HFA prefill or decode KV windows. GGML_OPENVINO_KV_ONLY_PREFILL=0 turns it off; the earlier name GGML_OPENVINO_NPU_KV_ONLY_PREFILL is still accepted. Gemma 4 E2B Q4_0 on NPU (KV_SLICE=0, NPU_TURBO=YES): llama-bench pp512 1320-1375 -> 2349-2454 t/s, pp2048 1146-1202 -> 2268-2513 t/s; E4B pp512 587 -> 773, pp2048 591 -> 847 t/s. llama-server, E2B, 3016-token prompt, prefill chunk 512, context checkpoints off: 1097-1108 -> 2136-2448 t/s.
